author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR adds `TracksterInferenceByShowerShape`, a trackster inference plugin that identifies the particle type of a trackster from its shower shape with one ONNX model. A producer selects it with its `inferenceAlgo` parameter. No default configuration selects it, so this PR changes no workflow output. The TICLv6 configuration (a later PR) uses it.

Two modes, chosen with `mode`:
- `em` (default): 16 trackster quantities give an EM score s. The trackster gets P(photon) = s and P(charged hadron) = 1 - s. The quantities are log(1 + raw energy), the CE-E energy fraction, |eta| and |z| of the barycenter, log(1 + number of layer clusters), the logs of the three PCA eigenvalues, the first eigenvalue over their sum, the three sigmas, the three PCA sigmas, and |eta of the main axis - eta of the barycenter|.
- `mixture`: the 16 quantities and 6 values of the layer-cluster profile give the 8 probabilities in `ticl::Trackster::ParticleType` order. The profile is in the new helper `ticl::layerClusterProfile` (`interface/TracksterLayerClusterProfile.h`): the largest layer-cluster energy share, the energy shares within 2 and 5 cm of the main axis, the energy-weighted transverse rms, the smallest |z| and the |z| extent.

Only tracksters with a raw energy of at least `minEnergy` (default 1 GeV) get an identification; the others keep their probabilities. A trackster with no PCA axis (for example a recovery trackster) uses the direction of its barycenter for the profile.

The constructor checks the model against the mode and throws a `Configuration` exception when the output name is not in the model, when the output has the wrong number of values per trackster (1 for `em`, 8 for `mixture`), or when the model does not accept the input width of the mode. `mode` accepts only `em` and `mixture`.

`TrackstersProducer` adds the plugin to its parameter description. The generated `trackstersProducer_cfi` therefore has one more default PSet, `pluginInferenceAlgoTracksterInferenceByShowerShape`; the default `inferenceAlgo` does not change.

Models: the plugin reads its model with `edm::FileInPath`. The default is `RecoTICL/Inference/data/showerShapePID/shapePID_v1.onnx` (mode `em`, input [n, 16], output `em` [n]). The TICLv6 configuration uses `mixPID_hi_v2.onnx` and `mixPID_fin_v2.onnx` (mode `mixture`, input [n, 22], output `pid` [n, 8]). The three files are in the cms-data package `RecoTICL-Inference`, in cms-data/RecoTICL-Inference#1. The package must be in the IB before this PR: cms-data/RecoTICL-Inference#1 and the cmsdist PR that adds `data-RecoTICL-Inference`. Until then, test with cms-data/RecoTICL-Inference#1.

#### PR validation:

On CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-17-2300 (master e2fed1b5919), el8_amd64_gcc14, with the model files of cms-data/RecoTICL-Inference#1 in the data area:
- `scram b` after `scram b clean`, `scram b code-format` (no change), `scram b code-checks` (findings only in external Eigen headers) and `scram b check-headers`: clean.
- New unit tests, both pass:
  - `testTracksterShowerShapeFeatures` (116 assertions, no model needed): the feature order and values on a hand-made trackster, equal features for both z signs, a trackster with a zero main axis, an empty trackster, and the profile with a shared layer cluster, one layer cluster, and all layer-cluster energies 0.
  - `testTracksterInferenceByShowerShape` (76 assertions): runs the `em` model and the `mixture` model on hand-made tracksters (one without PCA at negative z, one below `minEnergy` whose probabilities must not change), and 5 wrong configurations that must throw.
- cmsRun, D127, PU200 Z to mumu, 3 events, RAW2DIGI,RECO with clones of `ticlTrackstersCLUE3DHigh` and `ticlTrackstersRecovery` that use the plugin:
  - `em` with `shapePID_v1.onnx`: 8700 of 9188 CLUE3D tracksters and 476 of 88129 recovery tracksters are at or above 1 GeV and get an identification. The probabilities are in [0, 0.993], only photon and charged hadron are non-zero, and they sum to 1 within 3e-8.
  - `mixture` with `mixPID_hi_v2.onnx` and with `mixPID_fin_v2.onnx`: the probabilities are in [0, 0.965] and sum to 1 within 6e-7.
  - `mode = "foo"` fails at parameter validation; `mode = "mixture"` with the `em` model fails at module construction with a `Configuration` exception.
title: RecoTICL/Inference: shower-shape identification of tracksters
